load_r_squared_metric: load the r_squared evaluation metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library
compute_r_squared_score: compute the r_squared score given predictions and references arrays
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive gradio widget for the r_squared metric
evaluate_r_squared_predictions: evaluate model predictions against ground truth references using r_squared metric
run_r_squared_metric: run the r_squared metric to measure how well predictions fit the reference data
